_provenance.note: K-3/H-3 follow-up (2026-08-24): closes 2 of the 4 originally-flagged ML-DSA extended-mode gaps (Context, pre-hash/HashML-DSA) with real NIST ACVP-Server tr1 revision data, verified against the real engine via the new hsm_verifyBytesMLDSA wasm binding. Deterministic-mode and External-Mu remain OPEN, not fabricated: Deterministic testing needs an ML-DSA private-key-import wasm binding that does not exist yet (only public-key import and fresh-keypair generation are exposed); External Mu needs new PKCS#11 mechanism/parameter wiring in the Rust engine's FFI layer itself (rust/src/ffi.rs) — the capability exists at the native Rust level (sign_ml_dsa_external_mu/verify_ml_dsa_external_mu in crypto/handlers.rs, used by the KMIP layer) but is not reachable through PKCS#11 C_* calls at all, so no wasm/PKCS#11 binding can expose it without that engine-side work first.
